subindicator: auditory streaming from salient species-recognition cue differences
interpretation: Perceptually salient species-recognition cue differences did not promote auditory streaming. This coexists with strong positive acoustic communication/phonotaxis evidence.

task_context: laboratory web-site tenacity after different rearing/feeding histories
interpretation: No differences in giving-up times/site tenacity across experience treatments. This does not erase separate numerosity/memory evidence.

subindicator: turn alternation response to predator cues across exposure timescales
task_context: short-term versus one-week indirect exposure to predatory-ant cues
interpretation: No increase after short-term cue exposure, but significantly greater turn alternation after one week; this is a timescale-dependent response, not a simple negative.
